blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: merge sort — Sort by merging sorted runs.
auxiliary space — Extra memory beyond input.

blocks.title: Observe
blocks.text: Merge sort divides the input into smaller runs; merging two already sorted runs repeatedly selects the smallest available front value.

blocks.title: Apply
blocks.text: This bottom-up variant starts with single-item runs and doubles run width; it needs no recursive calls. The top-down variant recursively splits to length 0/1, then merges on return; Lesson 186 connects the two.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: Worst-case time O(n log n); standard array merging uses O(n) extra space. Include comparisons, not just the final sorted sequence.
